title: Matt Damon Loves the Memes About Him Getting Stranded—and He Wants More!
summary: Have you ever noticed that Matt Damon's characters get stranded a lot? In The Martian, he's stuck on Mars. In Interstellar, he's lost on a distant planet. In Saving Private Ryan, soldiers have to rescue him from behind enemy lines. And now, in his new movie The Odyssey, he plays Odysseus, a Greek hero who gets stranded over and over on his way home from war. The internet has turned this into a hilarious meme—and Damon loves it! "I've seen those memes," he said with a laugh. "They're funny. Friends send them to me. My kids sent one to me. How much money's been spent trying to bring me back from places?" It turns out, Hollywood has spent about $600 million making movies where Matt Damon gets stranded. But those movies have earned almost $2 billion at the box office—so it's a pretty good deal! One fan even calculated that in the world of Interstellar, it would have cost $900 billion to rescue Damon's character. "That is a lot of jet fuel," Damon joked. Anne Hathaway, who stars with him in both Interstellar and The Odyssey, teased him: "He's played really smart, stranded men." Damon says he's not done yet. "I'm gonna ride this pony until it runs out," he said. "I'm up for it wherever it is. It's worked out really well." So, if you see Matt Damon stuck somewhere on screen again, just remember: he's in on the joke, and he's having a blast.
why_it_matters: It shows that even famous actors can laugh at themselves and enjoy jokes fans make about them, reminding us to find humor in our own habits.
